sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "booth_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "theme_profile" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (theme_profile IN ('porcelainStudio', 'lightOak', 'darkroomWalnut')), "contrast_preference" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (contrast_preference IN ('system', 'standard', 'high')), "motion_preference" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (motion_preference IN ('system', 'reduced')), "default_lens" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (default_lens IN ('front', 'back', 'external')), "default_mirror_preview" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (default_mirror_preview IN (0, 1)), "default_mirror_output" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (default_mirror_output IN (0, 1)), "default_orientation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (default_orientation IN ('portrait', 'landscape')), "default_output_format" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (default_output_format IN ('jpeg', 'png')), "default_jpeg_quality" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (default_jpeg_quality BETWEEN 80 AND 100), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "booth_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES booth_profiles(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "event_date" TEXT CHECK (event_date IS NULL OR event_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "venue" TEXT CHECK (venue IS NULL OR length(venue) <= 80), "notes" TEXT CHECK (notes IS NULL OR length(notes) <= 1000), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'archived')), "lens" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lens IN ('front', 'back', 'external')), "mirror_preview" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mirror_preview IN (0, 1)), "mirror_output" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mirror_output IN (0, 1)), "guest_orientation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (guest_orientation IN ('portrait', 'landscape')), "shot_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (shot_count BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "countdown_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (countdown_seconds BETWEEN 2 AND 10), "shot_interval_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (shot_interval_seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "retake_policy" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (retake_policy IN ('none', 'perShot', 'wholeSession')), "retake_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "welcome_title" TEXT CHECK (welcome_title IS NULL OR length(welcome_title) <= 60), "welcome_message" TEXT CHECK (welcome_message IS NULL OR length(welcome_message) <= 200), "consent_text" TEXT CHECK (consent_text IS NULL OR length(consent_text) <= 400), "guest_chooses_template" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (guest_chooses_template IN (0, 1)), "finish_timeout_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (finish_timeout_seconds BETWEEN 10 AND 120), "theme_override" TEXT CHECK (theme_override IS NULL OR theme_override IN ('porcelainStudio', 'lightOak', 'darkroomWalnut')), "output_format" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (output_format IN ('jpeg', 'png')), "jpeg_quality" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (jpeg_quality BETWEEN 80 AND 100), "retention_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (retention_mode IN ('keepUntilDeleted', 'deleteAfterDays')), "retention_days" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT, CHECK((retake_policy = 'none' AND retake_limit = 0)OR(retake_policy <> 'none' AND retake_limit BETWEEN 1 AND 5)), CHECK((retention_mode = 'keepUntilDeleted' AND retention_days IS NULL)OR(retention_mode = 'deleteAfterDays' AND retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365)), CHECK((status = 'archived')=(archived_at IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "booth_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES booth_profiles(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "setup_completed_at" TEXT, "booth_event_id" TEXT REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE SET NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operator_access" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "recovery_verifier" TEXT, "pin_failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pin_failures >= 0), "pin_last_failure_at" TEXT, "recovery_failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (recovery_failures >= 0), "recovery_last_failure_at" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "category" TEXT CHECK (category IS NULL OR length(category) <= 40), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_number >= 1), "document_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (document_schema_version >= 1), "manifest_path" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(manifest_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND manifest_path NOT LIKE '/%' AND manifest_path NOT LIKE '%..%' AND instr(manifest_path, char(92)) = 0), "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(checksum) = 64), "page_width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (page_width_px BETWEEN 1 AND 20000), "page_height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (page_height_px BETWEEN 1 AND 20000), "photo_slot_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (photo_slot_count BETWEEN 0 AND 8), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(template_id, revision_number));
CREATE TRIGGER template_revisions_are_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON template_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'template revisions are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 64 AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (media_type IN ('png', 'jpeg', 'ttf', 'otf')), "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (relative_path = 'assets/' || id || '.' || CASE media_type WHEN 'png' THEN 'png' WHEN 'jpeg' THEN 'jpg' WHEN 'ttf' THEN 'ttf' WHEN 'otf' THEN 'otf' END), "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_length BETWEEN 1 AND 52428800), "width_px" INTEGER CHECK (width_px IS NULL OR width_px BETWEEN 1 AND 12000), "height_px" INTEGER CHECK (height_px IS NULL OR height_px BETWEEN 1 AND 12000), "display_name" TEXT CHECK (display_name IS NULL OR length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), "origin" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('imported', 'package', 'bundled')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK((media_type IN ('png', 'jpeg'))=(width_px IS NOT NULL AND height_px IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(media_type IN ('png', 'jpeg') OR byte_length <= 20971520));

CREATE TRIGGER asset_content_is_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF id, media_type, relative_path, byte_length, width_px, height_px, origin, created_at ON assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'assets are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_revision_assets" ("template_revision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_revisions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(template_revision_id, asset_id));
CREATE INDEX template_revision_assets_by_asset ON template_revision_assets (asset_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_drafts" ("template_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES templates(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "base_revision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_revisions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "document" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(document) BETWEEN 2 AND 1048576), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX events_by_status ON events (status, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_templates" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "template_revision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_revisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 11), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_default IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(event_id, template_revision_id), UNIQUE(event_id, position));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_templates_one_default ON event_templates (event_id) WHERE is_default = 1
CREATE INDEX event_templates_by_revision ON event_templates (template_revision_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "original_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Za-z-]*'), "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (relative_path = 'originals/' || id || '.jpg'), "width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (width_px BETWEEN 1 AND 20000), "height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (height_px BETWEEN 1 AND 20000), "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_length BETWEEN 1 AND 104857600), "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "lens" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lens IN ('front', 'back', 'external')), "sensor_orientation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sensor_orientation IN (0, 90, 180, 270)), "device_orientation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (device_orientation IN ('portraitUp', 'landscapeLeft', 'portraitDown', 'landscapeRight', 'unknown')), "exif_orientation" INTEGER CHECK (exif_orientation IS NULL OR exif_orientation BETWEEN 1 AND 8), "mirror_preview" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mirror_preview IN (0, 1)), "mirror_output" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mirror_output IN (0, 1)), "origin" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('diagnostics', 'session', 'legacy')), "captured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "committed_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX original_photos_by_time ON original_photos (captured_at)
CREATE TRIGGER original_photos_are_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON original_photos BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'originals are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_original_commits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Za-z-]*'), "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_length >= 1), "metadata" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(metadata) BETWEEN 2 AND 65536), "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
